sections.label: Core services, delivered without the jargon
text: Core services, delivered without the jargon
From routine compliance to one-off advice, everything is priced clearly and explained in plain English.
Annual Accounts & Corporation Tax
Statutory accounts and CT600 returns prepared and filed on time, with a plain-English summary of what the numbers mean for you.
Bookkeeping & VAT
Monthly bookkeeping in Xero, QuickBooks or FreeAgent, with MTD-compliant VAT returns prepared and reviewed before submission.
Payroll & Auto-Enrolment
Weekly or monthly payroll runs, payslips, P60s/P45s and pension auto-enrolment handled end to end for teams of any size.
Self-Assessment
Personal tax returns for directors, landlords and sole traders, with every allowance and relief checked before we file.
Tax Planning & Structuring
Salary/dividend mixes, pension contributions, incorporation and extraction strategies designed to keep more of what you earn.
Business Advisory
Cash flow forecasts, management accounts and a quarterly review call so decisions are backed by current numbers, not guesswork.

sections.label: Common questions before switching
text: Common questions before switching
How quickly can you take over from my current accountant?
Most clients are fully onboarded within two weeks. We request professional clearance and your records directly from your previous accountant, so you don't need to chase anything yourself.
Do your fees really stay fixed?

Yes. Your monthly fee is agreed before we start and covers everything listed in your package. If your business changes significantly — for example, you take on employees — we'll discuss any adjustment with you in advance, never after the fact.
Which accounting software do you support?
We work primarily with Xero, QuickBooks and FreeAgent. If you're not yet using cloud software, we'll set you up and provide training as part of onboarding.
Can you help with IR35 specifically?
Yes. We carry out contract-by-contract IR35 assessments for contractors and advise on the most tax-efficient way to operate, whether that's inside or outside IR35.
Do you work with clients outside the West Midlands?
Yes, the majority of our clients work with us entirely remotely by phone, email and video call. Office visits are available by appointment for those who prefer to meet in person.
